title: Ticket Tax on Unreturned Fare Value: Proration of Crestline Companion Taxes-and-Fees Refunds
content:
**Rule.** For a cancelled booking on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product, the taxes and fees that come back follow the share of the fare-side value that came back, because the ticket tax follows the fare value that actually comes back.

- **Fare-side value** — the booking's most recent companion fare charge plus the most recent Hawaii surcharge charge when that surcharge was charged on the same entry date as the companion fare.
- **Fare-side value refunded** — the most recent companion fare refund plus the most recent Hawaii surcharge refund when that surcharge refund was recorded on the same entry date as the companion fare refund. Where the certificate carries no companion fare refund, or no such same-date surcharge refund, that part is taken as zero.
- **Fare-side share** — the fare-side value refunded divided by the fare-side value.

| Fare-side share | Taxes and fees that come back |
|---|---|
| below 0.85 | the taxes and fees in that same share, rounded half up to the cent |
| 0.85 or more but below one | the taxes and fees less the ticket tax of 7.5 percent on the fare-side value that was not refunded, rounded half up to the cent |
| one (the whole fare-side value came back) | the taxes and fees in full |

The fare-side value not refunded is the fare-side value less the fare-side value refunded.

## Hypothetical worked cases (taxes-and-fees charge 40.00 USD; companion fare 249.00 USD and Hawaii surcharge 100.00 USD charged on the same date, fare-side value 349.00 USD)

| Fare-side value refunded | Share | Taxes and fees coming back |
|---|---|---|
| 349.00 (fare and surcharge refunds on the same date) | 1 | 40.00 |
| 300.00 | about 0.8596 | 40.00 less 7.5 percent of 49.00 (3.675), that is 36.325, rounded to 36.33 |
| 249.00 (surcharge refund recorded on a different date, so not counted) | about 0.7135 | 28.54 |
| 174.50 | 0.5 | 20.00 |

A Hawaii surcharge charged on a different entry date from the companion fare does not enter the fare-side value.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
